originality.rationale: Exact-language archived primary full text (Gomaa 2007) focuses on abelian groups, not the symmetric-group six-class rank-two spectrum. Wilf proves the classical square-root cycle-parity criterion, credited in the proof; it alone does not imply the ordinary two-round group logical-type classification. He (2014) and Grochow–Levet (2022) concern different structures or different logical resources. Ten searches of published mathematical records and earlier research-claim ledger comparisons found no covering statement. Comparisons use implications, not mere title differences. A historical unindexed equivalent theorem remains possible, and global uniqueness is not claimed.
residual_risks: Unindexed, inaccessible or not-full-text-inspected works on symmetric groups and two-round games may already state an equivalent theorem.
Wilf’s classical square-root criterion must not be described as new; only the logical classification and sharp finite representative bound are claimed.
Literature comparisons do not constitute proof of global novelty.
